name: track profile deformations
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 轨道几何型面相对于基准状态的偏移或改变。

complete_examples.text: A track irregularity inversion model is presented to obtain realistic representations of track profile deformations with information regarding amplitudes, wavelengths and probabilities.

To guarantee the safety, comfort and stability of the running vehicle in the presence of track profile deformations, several dynamic indices, including car body accelerations, wheel-rail forces, wheel-rail relative displacements, wheel unloading rate and derailment coefficient, will be adopted to evaluate the irregularity limits.

P002.title: A novel model for determining the amplitude-wavelength limits of track irregularities accompanied by a reliability assessment in railway vehicle-track dynamics
